pages: Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, stands at the quay edge with her inked hand flat on one black iron mooring bollard, looking across the water. Middle distance: a coil of tarred rope, the moored ferry. Background: the river, the wet sand bar, geese on it. Grey daylight.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, leans in to the tide gauge on the harbour wall, one hand up at the pointer on its brass arm. Middle distance: the copper well, the ruled board, a turning drum. Background: stone wall, estuary, low grey light.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, stands at the harbour office table and writes four figures down one under another on a foolscap sheet. Middle distance: an inkwell, brass dividers, an open tide table. Background: the office window, the river below. Grey daylight.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, stands at the gauge with one hand on the drum the day's curve is wound round, the pen arm touching its paper. Middle distance: the copper well, the pointer. Background: the harbour wall, the estuary, low evening light.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, sits writing the twelve times out by hand in a fair round hand on one foolscap sheet. Middle distance: an inkstand, a blotter, oilcloth-wrapped sheets in a stack. Background: the harbour office, morning light from the window.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, walks one fingertip down a column of tide figures in an open table, her pencil marking the row. Middle distance: an inkwell, brass dividers, her own sums. Background: the office window, grey daylight.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, leans out into hard rain at the harbour wall, one hand on the copper well while water sheets over the board. Middle distance: the drum, the pointer. Background: the quay, the river in spate, low grey light.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, stands at the gauge in the dark holding one oil lamp, watching the pointer stop and start again. Middle distance: the copper well, the drum with its pen arm. Background: the harbour wall, black river, lamplight on wet stone.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, stands at the end of Harklow Quay looking down into shallow brown water, one hand on an iron-banded timber pile. Middle distance: the ferry ramp, a mooring chain. Background: miles of river, low sun on the water.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, holds one brass lamp up to the tide gauge on the harbour wall in the dark, her shadow long on the stone. Middle distance: the copper well, the drum. Background: the quay, the black river, night.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, stands on the ferry ramp with one brass lamp in her hand, watching the pointer on the wall stay still. Middle distance: the ramp planks, the handrail. Background: the open river, the sand bar, wind and dark.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, grips the bar of one iron capstan on the quay above, looking down at the ferry lying aground far off on the bar. Middle distance: a coil of hawser, a mooring ring. Background: the wide river, geese, hard pale morning.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, writes the day's crossings on one foolscap sheet at the office table, the wooden case taken down flat. Middle distance: an inkstand, a blotting roll, the glass-front of the case. Background: the office wall, grey afternoon light.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, kneels on the office floor holding one candle in a shallow brass dish, going along a long strip of unrolled paper. Middle distance: rolled sheets, a wooden crate, the tin. Background: bare boards and skirting, low candle light.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, crouches over one long unrolled gauge strip on the floor, a finger pressed on a second dip in its curve. Middle distance: the candle dish, rolled paper, a brass rule. Background: the office floor, the wall, low light.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, stands holding one framed sheet of paper turned face down in both hands, reading its back. Middle distance: a coil of picture wire, a candle dish on the floor. Background: the office wall with a bare nail, cold grey light.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, works at the office table over one ruled sheet of arithmetic, filling it line by line. Middle distance: an inkwell, a brass letter opener, a folded letter. Background: the office window, low evening light.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, stands in the ferry waiting room with one finger on the printed sheet inside its glass-fronted wooden case. Middle distance: wooden benches, a stove. Background: the window over the quay, grey daylight.

Adela Rayner, grey at the temples, navy serge coat buttoned to the third brass button, grey wool scarf, draws a ruled line under a column of figures in one open book with her pen, then shuts it. Middle distance: the wooden case, an inkstand, the lamp. Background: the harbour office window, lamplight.
